subject: Re: Accelerating GCP private-offer commit drawdown for OrionAI
messages:
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@orionai.com>

Cc: Aisha Khan <aisha.k@orionai.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 14:12:00 -0400
Subject: Accelerating GCP private-offer commit drawdown

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the demo last week — OrionAI is excited about the latency and cost profile on the benchmark you shared. We ran numbers with our finance team and want to accelerate the drawdown on the private offer: if we can pull forward the first two quarters of committed credits into Q3, we can start a larger pilot and push the joint GTM.

Two asks:
- Can you share a version of the private-offer term sheet that supports a frontloaded drawdown and earlier invoice alignment?
- What operational steps do you need from us to enable co-sell handoff to GCP (account team loop-in, marketplace listing flags)?

We have Procurement on-copy (procurement@orionai.com) and can get a PO intent within 48 hours if we align on cadence.

Appreciate it —
Sanjay
Sanjay Patel
Head of AI Platform, OrionAI
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@orionai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 09:08:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Accelerating GCP private-offer commit drawdown

Sanjay — thanks for the clear ask and the quick turnaround offer. Attaching a term-sheet draft that models a Q3 frontload (attached: private_offer_term_sheet_v1.pdf). High level:

- We can frontload up to 40% of committed credits into the first 60 days of the contract, with staggered invoicing to match your accounting needs.
- We recommend a short co-sell readiness checklist: GCP account team contact, primary technical contact for onboarding, and marketing collateral alignment.
- For a larger pilot, we suggest enabling the marketplace listing as "co-sell enabled" so GCP can route leads; that requires a marketplace listing flag from your side + our listing team to confirm.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm PO intent and preferred invoice cadence (monthly/quarterly).
2) If OK, Marissa will coordinate the marketplace/co-sell handoff and loop in our partner ops.
3) Jonas will own the billing mapping and invoice schedule.

If that works, I can produce a term-sheet v2 for signatures by early next week.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Head of Marketplace Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Looping in the co-sell folks and partner ops. Priya — quick operational notes from partner side: 

- I will open a partner case with GCP to request the "co-sell enabled" flag and attach the ORN-114 term sheet. That process typically takes 3-5 business days after we submit the packet.
- We should include a 1-page joint solution brief for GCP; Sanjay, can you share a one-pager?
- For invoicing: if OrionAI wants frontloaded credits with staggered invoices, we need a short amendment to the private-offer terms (legal) — I'll +Legal after you confirm the high-level cadence.

HubSpot note: I added the proposed milestones to the deal (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/ORN-2026-114) so we can track co-sell tasks.

Marissa Cole
Director, GTM Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Hi Priya / Marissa,

On behalf of OrionAI procurement: we are prepared to issue a formal PO with the following preferences:
- PO intent: high-level PO to be issued within 48 hours after we receive the updated term sheet.
- Invoice cadence: prefer quarterly invoices aligned to redemption windows; however we can accept monthly invoices if Redwood requires earlier repayment terms for frontloaded credits.
- Billing contact: Aisha Khan (aisha.k@orionai.com).

Attached is a short PO intent sheet (orion_po_intent.pdf) — non-binding. Please provide the term-sheet v2 and the amendment language for the frontload so our legal can move quickly.

Thanks,
Procurement Team
